frontend.conflicts: positive repeated actual world-road within6cm conflicts remain uncertain, never silently background; no height crop, random seeds or static-track removal
frontend.aggregation: fixed GT local coordinates and same4cm voxel selection; no inferred pose replacement
frontend.DINOv3: real ViT-B16 layer7 remove5prefix, bilinear native features; official cosine matching plus Umeyama/RANSAC, compare with GT without changing points/poses; no per-image PCA, no AnyUp
frontend.uncertain_pool: preserve every withheld source return with reason, frame, rawrow, world/local coordinates and evidence

gate.limits: masks and world-road support are predicted/geometric proxies, not manual ownership GT; lowerbody means bottom25percent visible mask bbox, not exact tire labels; QUERY is development not new blind test

stop_policy: One finite final frontend attempt. If pointset not clearly better or 3k asset gate fails, preserve evidence, push existing branch, verify all own processes/queues and other GPU tasks idle, AutoDL shutdown; no more sweeps.
